`./compile.sh` reports **`compiled OK`**.

## What was created

`tests/org/apache/commons/lang3/builder/ToStringStyleAgentTest.java` — a self-contained JUnit 4 test class (matching `junit-4.12`/`junit-4.7` in `lib/`), compiled with `-source 8`.

### Fixtures (defined in-file)
- `Person` — stand-in for the javadoc's example object.
- `TestStyle` — a minimal concrete subclass (the class is abstract with a `protected` ctor and no abstract methods), used to exercise the inherited `protected` configuration API. The test lives in the class's own package, so `protected`/package-private members (`getShortClassName`, `appendClassName`, `register`, `getRegistry`, …) are reachable.

### Coverage (39 tests), all anchored to `api/`
- **Predefined singletons** — non-null; each of the 5 styles rendered via `appendStart`/`append`/`appendEnd` and checked against its *documented example output*: `DEFAULT_STYLE` shape (`name=John Doe`, `@hash`, `[...]`, `,`-separated, single line), `SHORT_PREFIX_STYLE` (field names kept, no `@`), `NO_FIELD_NAMES_STYLE` (`[John Doe,33,false]`, no `name=`), `SIMPLE_STYLE` (exact `John Doe,33,false`), `MULTI_LINE_STYLE` (multiple `System.lineSeparator()`, ends `LS + "]"`). Serialization round-trips to the same singleton instance ("intended to be used as Singletons").
- **`append` overloads** — every primitive + Object + array overload; detail vs. summary contract from the class doc ("detail … outputs the whole array, whereas the summary … just the array length"), `null` fullDetail falling back to the style default, `null` array/value → null text, `null` field name → name omitted.
- **Documented defaults** (from `serialized-form.html`): `contentStart='['`, `nullText='<null>'`, `<size=`/`>`, `useClassName`/`useFieldNames`/`useIdentityHashCode` = `true`, `useShortClassName` = `false`, etc.
- **Setter/getter round trips** — booleans both ways; every text setter's *"null → empty String"* contract.
- **`protected` helpers** — `appendContentStart/End`, `appendFieldSeparator/Start/End`, `appendNullText` (default `<null>`), `appendSummarySize` (default `<size=n>`), `removeLastFieldSeparator` (trailing-only, no-op on empty), `appendClassName`/`appendIdentityHashCode` (flag + null handling, exact `@<hex>`), `getShortClassName` (package stripped), `isFullDetail` (request then default).
- **`appendSuper`/`appendToString`** — null ignored, marker-less/empty-content strings ignored, inner field content extracted.
- **Registry** — `register`/`isRegistered`/`unregister`/`getRegistry` lifecycle; `appendStart` registers the target and `appendEnd` unregisters it.

No shared singleton is ever mutated (setters only touch local `TestStyle` instances), so tests stay independent.
